description:
[read-only] What an Ads Manager export (CSV text, or a base64 .xlsx) would import, without writing: the column mapping found, columns left unmapped, the first rows, malformed rows by line number, and each conflict with a synced row (the synced value is kept). Run this before ads_import_commit.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/imports/files/preview.)

adAccountId.description: The ad account the export belongs to, stored with each row.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

csv.description: The export as CSV text. Send exactly one of csv or xlsxBase64.

currency.description: A 3-letter currency for a file with no currency column, such as USD.

dateOrder.description: How to read a date such as 04/05/2026. Default: mdy (month first).

fileName.description: The export file name. Kept with each imported row.

level.description: The row level, for rows with no level cell. Default: the deepest level the mapped columns identify.

mapping.description: Field to column header, for columns the network preset does not recognise. Fields: date, dateEnd, level, campaignId, campaignName, adsetId, adsetName, adId, adName, accountId, spend, currency, impressions, reach, clicks, linkClicks, results, resultType, leads, conversions, thruplays, videoViews3s, videoViews. Omit to use the preset; the preview returns the mapping it found.

platform.description: The ad network the export came from.

timezone.description: The ad account time zone (IANA, such as America/Chicago), used for timestamps that carry an offset. Default: UTC. A plain date is kept as written.

xlsxBase64.description: An .xlsx export, base64 encoded (standard alphabet, no line breaks). The first sheet is read.

name: ads_import_preview
title: Preview a stats file import
